October 10th is available, and 80 guests fits our standing capacity nicely! I have to be upfront though: I don't have any returning-customer or off-season discounts to offer, and the weekend full-day buyout is $3,600 — plus a $500 refundable security deposit — so $2,400 all-in wouldn't be workable for a full day on that date.

If budget is the main constraint, a shorter booking (say 5–6 hours instead of a full buyout at $260/hour) could bring the venue cost down significantly — want me to run those numbers for you? I can also connect you with our events manager to see if there's any flexibility, and they'll follow up by email today.
